office_does: The county treasurer collects property taxes for Garfield County and its taxing districts and receives, invests and pays out the county's money.
race_blurb: Treasurer Tereasa Summers, in office since 2019 after ten years as chief deputy, faces Katie Nagle, who has served as chief deputy treasurer and who reached the ballot as a write-in (230 write-in votes to Summers's 593 in the primary).

candidates.summary: Garfield County Treasurer since 2019 and chief deputy treasurer for ten years before that, with 25 years in county government.
highlights: Won the office in 2018 and was re-elected unopposed in 2022 [S3][S4]
Brought in an online property tax system and is working on a monthly payment option [S1]
593 votes in the primary to 230 write-ins [S5]

experience.basis: Incumbent treasurer since 2019, re-elected in 2022, after ten years as chief deputy and 25 years in county government; runs on that record.

candidates.summary: Has served as Garfield County chief deputy treasurer and has a banking background; who reached the general ballot through a write-in campaign.
highlights: Served as chief deputy treasurer; earlier worked at the Bank of Eastern Washington [S1][S2]
Says banking gives her 'a fresh perspective' and promises a 'consistent presence in the office' [S1]
Reached the ballot as a primary write-in [S2][S3][S5]

experience.basis: Challenger to a long-time incumbent, pitching banking experience and 'a fresh perspective'; has worked inside the office as chief deputy, so not +2.
